items.title: Grouped aggregation by story/phase/role/model/provider
items.context: In a new core/usage-ledger/diagnostics.ts (or report.ts), add aggregation that consumes summary.ts's selection (latest non-superseded per ledgerCallId+attemptId) and rolls up canonical token dimensions by storyId, phase, agentType/role, model, and provider. Reuse summary.ts; do NOT re-implement selection/bucketing. Provider-reported vs prompt-size-estimate vs unavailable kept separate; unknown/unavailable stays unknown (never 0); superseded estimates excluded from final totals. Unit-tested across groups.

happy.desc: aggregateByGroup with 3 records (2 stories, 2 models, 2 providers) -> returns groups keyed by storyId/phase/agentType/model/provider with correct per-group token sums; WHY: validates multi-dimensional rollup correctness

aggregateByGroup with provider-reported + prompt-size-estimate records -> estimate records appear in their own source bucket and are NOT mixed into provider-reported totals; WHY: validates source separation invariant

edge.desc: aggregateByGroup with record where source=unavailable -> group for that record shows unknown=true, total=null, NOT 0; WHY: unknown/unavailable must never silently become 0
aggregateByGroup with a superseded record -> superseded record excluded from all group totals; WHY: validates summary.ts selectLatestRecords integration

aggregateByGroup with record having one null dimension (e.g. cacheCreation=null) -> that records total is unknown/null, not partially summed; WHY: partial-null must not silently produce a numeric total
aggregateByGroup with storyId=null (non-story call) -> groups by storyId=null as a distinct group key, not dropped; WHY: non-story calls are valid and must not be silently lost

adversarial.desc: aggregateByGroup with duplicate ledgerCallId+attemptId at different sequences -> only highest-sequence record selected per attempt, lower-sequence excluded from totals; WHY: validates dedup-by-sequence under data race
aggregateByGroup with empty records array -> returns empty groups, no crash, no NaN; WHY: edge-of-empty must be safe

aggregateByGroup with 100+ records across 10 stories, 5 models, 3 providers -> groups partition correctly and sum to the same grand total as summarizeRecords; WHY: scale cross-check prevents off-by-one or double-count

items.title: Pure cost projection with an INJECTED price table
items.context: Add a pure cost function that takes an injected price table (per-model rates for input/output/cacheRead/cacheCreation $/MTok, including the cache multipliers) and a group's token totals -> cost. NO hardcoded prices anywhere. When no price table is supplied, cost is null/omitted (not 0). Record a pricingRef/pricingVersion when a table is supplied. Unknown token dimensions -> cost unknown (never treated as 0). Tested: cost computed with a sample table; null when no table; unknown stays unknown.

items.title: Read-only diagnostics report builder (feeds no gate)
items.context: Add a buildUsageReport(records, {priceTable?}) that assembles a structured report object: overall totals (by source), per-group breakdowns (story/model/role/...), counts (provider-reported/estimate/unavailable), unknown count, and optional cost when a price table is given. It MUST be read-only and feed NO gate (no gate/verdict/decision/blocker field; not imported by any handler/gate). Tested: report shape correct; no gate-consumable field; deterministic.

items.title: Runnable reporter task (npm script, not a CLI command)
items.context: Add packages/main/src/tasks/usage-ledger-report.ts that reads a ledger JSONL path (arg/env) and an optional price-table path, builds the report, and prints it (human-readable + a JSON mode). Wire it as an npm script (e.g. usage-ledger-report). Do NOT register a lattice CLI command and do NOT touch the command registry / cli-engine / handlers — the entry point stays a task to honor the no-other-logic constraint. Tested: running it over a sample ledger prints a correct report and exits 0.

items.title: Smoke/test suite wired into package.json
items.context: Add packages/main/src/tasks/usage-ledger-diagnostics-smoke.ts (follow existing *-smoke.ts pattern; ✓/✗, non-zero exit on failure; temp dir, no repo pollution), wired as npm test:usage-ledger-diagnostics. Cover: grouped aggregation correctness (by story/model/role/provider; unknown!=0; estimate excluded from provider totals; superseded excluded); cost projection with/without injected price table (null when absent; unknown stays unknown); report builder feeds no gate (no gate/verdict/decision field); the reporter task runs over a sample ledger and prints correctly; build green; and a static assert that the usage-ledger module still imports ZERO other Lattice modules. No regression in the other usage-ledger smokes.
